segments.comment: A debug-mode Valkyrie, whom set_playmode() names "wizard", level-teleports to D:2 of seed 1002, which has a tended armor shop (see recipes/bones.c/shopkeeper-level-bones), wishes for a wand of death, teleports into the shop, picks up a helm and teleports out. shk.c u_left_shop() -> rob_shop() calls hot_pursuit(), so the shopkeeper follows with customer "wizard". She zaps herself, and inherits() "comes and takes all your possessions" and sends the shopkeeper home, still following; she saves bones.

An ordinary-mode Archeologist named Bystander digs through D:1 with his pick-axe and lands on the bones level (getbones()'s rn2(3) is 0 for this seed). shk.c restshk() pacifies the angry shopkeeper because the customer is not Bystander, but following stays set; the shopkeeper comes out to him and shk_move() says "Hello, Bystander!  I was looking for wizard." and stops following.
